title: Neighbouring Countries - Magyarország szomszédai

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can name Hungary's seven neighbouring countries and describe where each one lies using compass directions.
I can explain which neighbouring countries are inside the EU and Schengen area, and which have external borders.
I can explain why significant historical Hungarian communities live across the borders in neighbouring countries.
I can use határos valamivel correctly with consonant assimilation (-val/-vel).
I can explain the concept of nemzeti összetartozás (national solidarity) in relation to cross-border Hungarian communities.
